items.title: Strengthening partnership for mangrove restoration
items.summary: Together, we restore. Together, we protect. Together, we grow!
items.body:
Today, East African Terminals returned to Bidii Creek once again to support our mangrove conservation and restoration efforts. Together, we planted 1,000 mangrove seedlings of the Avicennia marina species, carefully selected according to the specific zone and area targeted for restoration.

This is not the first time East African Terminals has partnered with us. Their continued commitment and support demonstrate the importance of strong partnerships in protecting, restoring, and conserving our precious mangrove ecosystems. We sincerely appreciate their continued collaboration and dedication to environmental sustainability.

We also extend our heartfelt appreciation to the Kenya Forest Service (KFS) for their continued technical support, guidance, and presence whenever we need them. Your contribution to our conservation journey is truly invaluable.

At Bidii Creek CBO, we believe that restoring our mangroves is a collective responsibility. Through partnerships, community participation, and consistent action, we can restore degraded areas, protect marine biodiversity, and secure a healthier environment for future generations.

items.title: 🌱BIDII CREEK CBO | MAZINGIRA DAY 2026🌱
items.summary:
🌱 **Our Environment, Our Responsibility!**
💚 **Collective Action for Tree Growing and Environmental Stewardship.**
items.body:
Today, we celebrated Mazingira Day by planting 1,000 mangrove seedlings at Bidii Creek! 🌱💚

Together with members of our community and other partners we joined hands with one common goal: protecting, restoring, and conserving our precious mangrove ecosystem.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who participated and contributed to making this day a success. Your commitment, teamwork, and dedication to environmental conservation are truly appreciated. 🙏🏽🌿

Mazingira Day is a special day for every Kenyan to come together and take responsibility for protecting our environment. Every seedling we plant today is a step towards a greener, healthier, and more sustainable future for generations to come.


#MazingiraDay2026 #BidiiCreekCBO #MangroveRestoration #EnvironmentalConservation #TreeGrowing #CommunityAction #BlueCarbon #ProtectOurEnvironment

items.title: International Coast Cleanup Day. 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻. 🌊🤝🏽
items.summary: Bidii Creek CBO Partnered with Stand Up Shout Out (SUSO) for this cleanup event. Let us hear from our partners.
items.body:
Our journey with Bidii Creek Conservancy did not begin with this cleanup.

Since 2021, we have walked together, restoring mangroves, nature based@solutions beekeeping, strengthening community leadership, engaging young people and building a shared vision in which both people and the coastal ecosystem can thrive.

On International Coastal Cleanup Day 2026, that journey continued through community-led action.

Together with the Jomvu Community Scouts Unit, Bidii Creek Conservancy mobilized women, youth and children to clean their coastal environment. They organized, briefed one another, walked into the mangroves and got to work; one person, one gunia and one piece of waste at a time.

The work was muddy. It was tiring. And it mattered.

Every piece of plastic removed was one less threat to the mangroves, marine life and waterways upon which communities depend. Materials that could be recovered were collected for recycling and reuse, carrying the responsibility beyond the cleanup itself.

For SUSO, this is what partnership looks like.

It is walking alongside communities, investing in their leadership and trusting them to organize and act for the landscapes they call home.

Because thriving marine ecosystems need thriving communities and thriving communities are built when people recognize that they are not merely beneficiaries of conservation, but leaders within it.

That is Ubuntu.

Bidii played its part. The Jomvu Community Scouts played their part. SUSO played its part.

And together, we made our shared responsibility visible. 💚

#InternationalCoastalCleanupDay #BidiiCreekConservancy #SUSO #UbuntuInAction

items.title: Growing Avicennia marina 🌱🌳
items.summary: One of the most delicate mangrove species to raise from the nursery to the forest.
items.body:
Growing Avicennia marina seedlings is not as simple as putting a seed in the soil and waiting for it to grow. From the nursery stage, these young seedlings require patience, close monitoring, the right conditions and continuous care.

The most challenging moment comes when it is time to transport and transfer them from the nursery to the planting site. Their young roots and stems are delicate, and rough handling, excessive exposure to the sun, dehydration or damage during transportation can affect their survival.

That is why every seedling must be handled with extra care — carefully lifted, properly packed, transported safely and planted without damaging the root system.

At Bidii Creek CBO, we understand that mangrove restoration is not just about the number of seedlings planted. It is about giving every seedling the best possible chance to survive, grow and eventually become part of a healthy mangrove ecosystem. 🌱💚

Every seedling represents patience, hard work and hope for the future.
